mapper.select: SELECT current_grade(p.grade,p.grade_academic_year,(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date) grade,count(*) student_count FROM user_profile p LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id=p.major_id WHERE coalesce(p.college_id,m.college_id) IS NOT NULL AND p.major_id IS NOT NULL AND p.grade IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(p.college_id,m.college_id)=#{collegeId} AND p.major_id=#{majorId} GROUP BY 1

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM subject_user_access WHERE subject_id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id subject_id,count(DISTINCT b.id) FILTER(WHERE q.id IS NOT NULL) bank_count,count(q.id) question_count, count(f.question_id) answered_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='CORRECT') correct_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='WRONG') wrong_count FROM subject s LEFT JOIN question_bank b ON b.subject_id=s.id AND bank_visible(b.id,#{userId}) LEFT JOIN question q ON q.bank_id=b.id AND q.status='ACTIVE' AND NOT q.is_group LEFT JOIN facts f ON f.question_id=q.id AND f.rn=1 WHERE s.id IN #{id} GROUP BY s.id
